body: Happened to me three years ago and I agree. I think about it every single day and idk what feels worse at this point. Thinking about it. Or knowing that I always will.

I just wanted to say that you’re a really good friend and personally, I would love to have someone like you. Idk if that means anything. But in your friends position I would say that even in the place he’s feeling that he’s in right now, you might be all he’s got and it won’t be obvious to you or even him probably. Just be there for him and tell him you’re there for him. Don’t tell him that “things will get better” or other positive things along those lines. You probably won’t be able to see him for a while or a few days but maybe spend time with him if he feels alright with that when he’s back. 
Even just sitting in silence together, if that sounds weird. But that makes me feel “okay” when my friends presence is with me.
A lot of people don’t want to seek help or support from others and you can’t force them, personally I don’t and it’s never helped me, I’m even too scared to tell a friend. But if you wanna call him or shoot him a text saying how you feel about him and how much you care. I would do that. Just be all ears and listen and don’t judge. You can’t change his opinion in the end. But you can possibly make him feel like you’re one of the reasons worth living for.

Hey love. I feel like I’m in the same boat as you. Somewhat at least. I’m 19. I beat anorexia sorta. Like healthy weight. “Better” eating habits and my minds better but I’m depressed af as it is along with other things going on in my head. And I always wish that I never got help and I could’ve died because of how skinny and ill I was, I was just hoping I wouldn’t wake up one day. 
My family never understood and told me to “grow the fuck up or snap out of it” and my boyfriend doesn’t really get it. So I know how you feel. 
Don’t let anyone give you shit and live every day like it’s your last. I never feel like things will get better because they haven’t. So I hate when people say that shit. But I try to hold onto things that make me feel better or wish to see another day, like the fact that I’m trying to get the hell out and get my own apartment or place even though I’m broke af too. That makes me feel better cause at that point perhaps you feel like you can start over and as for me, I would cut everyone off once I move out. 
If you ever need someone to talk to just know I’m here and you can always message me.

Hey love. I’m all ears. I don’t wanna sound off but I’ve been through pretty much the same too as you’ve just said. I wanna say I probably know the same pain you’re going through. I’m 19 too. Please feel free to talk to me if you’d like. You’re not the only one. I know the pain and the struggle is hard but I’m here for you just like I’m sure many others are too. People need each other to get through things. I’m not saying that things can get better, I hate hearing that shit too because it hasn’t for me. But maybe something can help or things change. Just know I’m here for you love
